agorapulse.name: Agorapulse
agorapulse.tagline: Social inbox, scheduling and reporting for enterprises and agencies
agorapulse.desc: Agorapulse is a social media management platform built for agencies, brands, and social teams that pairs a unified inbox with scheduling, listening and reporting.
agorapulse.best: Agencies and enterprises managing multiple accounts.
features: Track and respond to all your social media interactions in one centralized Inbox
Plan and schedule your social media content across all platforms with an intuitive post scheduler and shared calendars
Monitor and track mentions of your brand, industry, and competitors by capturing conversations from social networks
Make better business decisions with actionable social media reports that don’t take all day to create

pricingTiers.name: Standard
pricingTiers.description: Built for social media managers handling it all themselves
features: 1 user, 10 profiles, unified inbox, scheduling, basic reports

pricingTiers.name: Professional
pricingTiers.description: Perfect for growing teams who need to move faster together
features: 1 user, 10 profiles, advanced inbox, scheduling, enhanced reports

pricingTiers.name: Advanced
pricingTiers.description: Ideal for enterprise teams needing structure and deeper insights
features: 1 user, 10 profiles, premium inbox, scheduling, comprehensive reports

audiense.name: Audiense
audiense.tagline: Audience intelligence and segmentation for X marketers.
audiense.desc: Audiense builds rich audience segments from X data — interests, influencers and personas — so brands understand exactly who follows them and why.
audiense.best: Marketers, researchers and agencies doing audience research.
